pet: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent game character sprite sheet for FLYZRDS. Create exactly 16 isolated full-body sprites in a perfectly regular FOUR column FOUR row square grid, ideally 1024x1024 with equal cells. Genuinely transparent background, no lines, text, labels, floor or cast shadows. One SAME original sci-fi LONG-NECK DINOSAUR in every cell, facing RIGHT. Pokemon-inspired anime creature design and clean cel shading, cute but fierce, more mature than a baby mascot: sleek compact muscular quadruped, long curved neck, angular muzzle, confident narrow amber eyes with angular brows, small swept-back ivory cranial horns, jade/teal skin, cream segmented throat/belly, dark indigo natural armored shoulder/back plates, short cyan bioluminescent dorsal spikes down neck/back/tail, three ivory claws per foot. Organic futuristic creature, NOT robot in a costume. Expressive but no huge toddler eyes or rosy cheeks. Strong readable silhouette, crisp dark outline, restrained 3-tone shading, simplify details for a 64px gameplay sprite. No existing Pokemon or Digimon character copying. No hats, capes, robes, staffs, wands or wizard clothing anywhere. Consistent anatomy, palette, size and identity across all 16 cells. At least 15% transparent padding around every sprite in its own cell, never cross cell boundaries. Exactly row-major poses: Row 1: idle alert standing; same standing blink; walking left-front leg forward; opposite walking leg forward. Row 2: head lowered nibbling small red berries; head raised chewing berries; paw reaching toward small simple sci-fi ball; paw resting on ball with confident pleased face. Row 3: curled sleeping head on tail; same sleeping relaxed breathing; neck poised emitting small cyan bioelectric charge from dorsal plates; head forward emitting short contained cyan energy breath with mouth open. Row 4: defensive braced stance with small cyan translucent geometric energy barrier in front; same defensive stance barrier pulses; proud roar with head raised and planted feet; celebratory small hop fierce happy eyes. Keep energies subtle and inside cell. Every complete silhouette entirely visible. No presentation background. These are animation frames, not a concept poster.
